common_controls.candidate_task_and_attack_inputs: identical frozen case manifest per batch

configurations.label: DRIFT Base
configurations.claim: Original DRIFT baseline, reported from the paper's full evaluation

configurations.label: Full RCVR
configurations.claim: Constraint-specific binding verification plus evidence-bounded recovery

configurations.label: w/o Binding Verification
configurations.claim: Keeps provenance/source-field tracking and original DRIFT validation, but disables all constraint-specific binding judgement

configurations.label: UNKNOWN to Stop
configurations.claim: Binding verification remains; UNKNOWN receives no recovery

configurations.label: UNKNOWN to Allow
configurations.claim: Binding verification remains; UNKNOWN is permissively dispatched without recovery

configurations.label: w/o Evidence Isolation
configurations.claim: Removes only RCVR recovery prompt separation between host control and untrusted evidence; all validators and DRIFT injection isolation remain fixed

reporting_constraints: Do not replace the historical AgentDojo main table with this targeted subset.
Report model, recovery, and APDE validation calls separately.
Report infrastructure/model failures separately from security success.
